trust_decision.summary: Whether a request-supplied value used to build a template name may leave the template directories; at the pinned commit nothing decides it: the Tags widget passes design_type through unchanged, and geodir_locate_template/geodir_get_template include whatever path results.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the Tags widget's 'design_type' parameter; this else-branch copies it into $style, which then becomes the template file name at :1064.

fix_sites.entry_point: unauthenticated admin-ajax action geodir_cpt_tags (nopriv; public basic nonce) -> GeoDir_Widget_Tags::get_tags_ajax_content($_POST) (includes/class-geodir-ajax.php:59, includes/class-geodir-ajax.php:709-712); also [gd_tags] shortcode/block attributes
public PHP API geodir_locate_template(), called by geodir_get_template()/geodir_get_template_html() from every widget, AJAX handler and addon
public PHP API geodir_get_template() (empty-location guard so include is skipped)
new helper geodir_is_safe_template_name() called from geodir_locate_template

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: includes/template-functions.php:180-204 (geodir_locate_template), fix.diff:43-79; it is the only thing that closes the other widgets' template-path routes

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names only the Tags widget's design_type. Allowlisting it the way the Categories widget already does (includes/widgets/class-geodir-widget-categories.php:1238-1243) looks complete, and the shared loader 'only loads trusted template names from callers'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Template names with subdirectories (bootstrap/tags/icon-left.php) must still resolve: first a theme override via locate_template in the theme's geodirectory/ folder, then the plugin templates dir. Addons and callers pass their own template_path/default_path. Segments merely containing '..' (e.g. 'foo..bar.php') stay allowed. Restricting realpath to the plugin templates dir, rejecting any '/', or rejecting any '..' substring breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: arbitrary non-allowlisted design_type value (widget falls back to icon-left)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Unauthenticated geodir_widget_listings AJAX: POST widget_args[design_style] becomes the template path prefix '<design_style>/content-widget-listing.php'. The published fix does not change this file; only the new central check in geodir_locate_template closes it.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different widget, different parameter name (design_style, not design_type), nested widget_args array shape, and a fixed file-name suffix, so it 'cannot include arbitrary files'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same directory as the landing point, different file; entry at includes/class-geodir-ajax.php:67,1464-1468 -> includes/widgets/class-geodir-widget-listings.php:887-894,992 -> :1789-1791

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Author Actions widget/shortcode attribute design_style becomes the template path prefix; not changed by the fix; covered only by the central guard.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only reachable through shortcode/block attributes set by a logged-in content author, not by an unauthenticated request.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Post Images and Loop widgets take design_style from args into the template prefix; not changed by the fix; covered only by the central guard.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Shortcode/block attribute route with author-level trust; no unauthenticated AJAX route was found in the time available.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second implementation, geodir_get_template_part($slug,$name), resolves and load_template()s '{$slug}-{$name}.php' and never calls the new safe-name check; a caller passing a request-derived $name (layout/view switch) would reopen the sink.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding a list/grid 'view' or skin switcher would naturally pass the request value as $name, as WooCommerce-style themes do; the published fix only hardens geodir_locate_template.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: recently_viewed_listings already reads template_type/tmpl_* from $_REQUEST; a design_style or item template param there would mirror the listings-widget route.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The neighbouring listings AJAX path already accepts design_style via widget_args, so parity is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The review item template name is built from $gd_review_template; relaxing the allowlist at includes/widgets/class-geodir-widget-single-reviews.php:98 to sanitize_file_name only would be a sanitizer that looks safe.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The code already applies sanitize_file_name at :687 as a second layer, so a maintainer could drop the allowlist believing that is enough.

O9_family: Local file inclusion via a template name built from request input (CWE-98 / path traversal into include)

O10_build.toolchain: WordPress core + PHP (readme says Requires PHP 5.6; any modern PHP 7.4-8.x); composer.json present for vendor libs (vendor/ already in tree)
O10_build.project_tests: none found in tree (no tests/ directory, no phpunit config); hidden tests would need a WP test harness or direct PHP calls to geodir_locate_template/geodir_get_template_html

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Allowlist design_type to icon-left/icon-top in the Tags widget only (copying the Categories widget), leaving geodir_locate_template and the listings widget_args[design_style] route open.
